## Setup

### libraries

```{r}
library(psych)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx2)
```

### load data

```{r}
df <- read_xlsx("../data/df_analysis.xlsx")
```

## Need for Cognition

### recode

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    RQ12.1_3R  = 6 - Q12.1_3,
    RQ12.1_4R  = 6 - Q12.1_4,
    RQ12.1_5R  = 6 - Q12.1_5,
    RQ12.1_7R  = 6 - Q12.1_7,
    RQ12.1_8R  = 6 - Q12.1_8,
    RQ12.1_9R  = 6 - Q12.1_9,
    RQ12.1_12R = 6 - Q12.1_12,
    RQ12.1_16R = 6 - Q12.1_16,
    RQ12.1_17R = 6 - Q12.1_17
  )
```

### items

```{r}
nfc_items <- c(
  "Q12.1_1",
  "Q12.1_2",
  "RQ12.1_3R",
  "RQ12.1_4R",
  "RQ12.1_5R",
  "Q12.1_6",
  "RQ12.1_7R",
  "RQ12.1_8R",
  "RQ12.1_9R",
  "Q12.1_10",
  "Q12.1_11",
  "RQ12.1_12R",
  "Q12.1_13",
  "Q12.1_14",
  "Q12.1_15",
  "RQ12.1_16R",
  "RQ12.1_17R",
  "Q12.1_18"
)
```

### check number of responses

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    NeedCog_n_answered = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(all_of(nfc_items)))
    )
  )

table(df$NeedCog_n_answered)
```

### sum and mean

```{r}
# df <- df %>%
#   mutate(
#     NeedCog_Sum = rowSums(
#       across(all_of(nfc_items)),
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     ),
# 
#     NeedCog_Mean = rowMeans(
#       across(all_of(nfc_items)),
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     )
#   )
```

```{r}
# Minimum response requirement, 15 items of 18
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    NeedCog_Mean = if_else(
      NeedCog_n_answered >= 15,
      rowMeans(
        across(all_of(nfc_items)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### Cronbach's alpha

```{r}
nfc_alpha <- psych::alpha(
  df %>%
    select(all_of(nfc_items))
)

nfc_alpha
```

```{r}
nfc_alpha$total$raw_alpha
```

```{r}
nfc_alpha$total$std.alpha
```

```{r}
nfc_alpha$item.stats
```

```{r}
nfc_alpha$alpha.drop
```

## Dirty Dozen

### items

```{r}
narcissism_items <- c(
  "Q11.1_9",
  "Q11.1_10",
  "Q11.1_11",
  "Q11.1_12"
)

psychopathy_items <- c(
  "Q11.1_5",
  "Q11.1_6",
  "Q11.1_7",
  "Q11.1_8"
)

machiavellianism_items <- c(
  "Q11.1_1",
  "Q11.1_2",
  "Q11.1_3",
  "Q11.1_4"
)
```

### completion

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    DirtyDozen_Narcissism_n = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(all_of(narcissism_items)))
    ),

    DirtyDozen_Psychopathy_n = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(all_of(psychopathy_items)))
    ),

    DirtyDozen_Machiavellianism_n = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(all_of(machiavellianism_items)))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
table(df$DirtyDozen_Narcissism_n)
table(df$DirtyDozen_Psychopathy_n)
table(df$DirtyDozen_Machiavellianism_n)
```

### means

```{r}
# df <- df %>%
#   mutate(
#     DirtyDozen_Narcissism = rowMeans(
#       across(all_of(narcissism_items)),
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     ),
# 
#     DirtyDozen_Psychopathy = rowMeans(
#       across(all_of(psychopathy_items)),
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     ),
# 
#     DirtyDozen_Machiavellianism = rowMeans(
#       across(all_of(machiavellianism_items)),
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     )
#   )
```

```{r}
# Minimum completion, 3 items of 5
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    DirtyDozen_Narcissism = if_else(
      DirtyDozen_Narcissism_n >= 3,
      rowMeans(across(all_of(narcissism_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),

    DirtyDozen_Psychopathy = if_else(
      DirtyDozen_Psychopathy_n >= 3,
      rowMeans(across(all_of(psychopathy_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),

    DirtyDozen_Machiavellianism = if_else(
      DirtyDozen_Machiavellianism_n >= 3,
      rowMeans(across(all_of(machiavellianism_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### Cronbach's alpha

```{r}
alpha_narcissism <- psych::alpha(
  df %>%
    select(all_of(narcissism_items))
)

alpha_narcissism
```

```{r}
alpha_psychopathy <- psych::alpha(
  df %>%
    select(all_of(psychopathy_items))
)

alpha_psychopathy
```

```{r}
alpha_machiavellianism <- psych::alpha(
  df %>%
    select(all_of(machiavellianism_items))
)

alpha_machiavellianism
```

```{r}
alpha_narcissism$total$raw_alpha
alpha_psychopathy$total$raw_alpha
alpha_machiavellianism$total$raw_alpha
```

## Cooperation

### items

```{r}
competition_items <- c(
  "Q10.1_1",
  "Q10.1_2",
  "Q10.1_3",
  "Q10.1_4"
)

cooperation_items <- c(
  "Q10.1_5",
  "Q10.1_6",
  "Q10.1_7",
  "Q10.1_8"
)
```

### recode competition

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    RQ10.1_1R = 6 - Q10.1_1,
    RQ10.1_2R = 6 - Q10.1_2,
    RQ10.1_3R = 6 - Q10.1_3,
    RQ10.1_4R = 6 - Q10.1_4
  )
```

```{r}
cooperation_scale_items <- c(
  "RQ10.1_1R",
  "RQ10.1_2R",
  "RQ10.1_3R",
  "RQ10.1_4R",
  "Q10.1_5",
  "Q10.1_6",
  "Q10.1_7",
  "Q10.1_8"
)
```

### completion

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Cooperation_n_answered = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(all_of(cooperation_scale_items)))
    )
  )

table(df$Cooperation_n_answered)
```

### mean

```{r}
# df <- df %>%
#   mutate(
#     Cooperation_Mean = rowMeans(
#       across(all_of(cooperation_scale_items)),
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     )
#   )
```

```{r}
# minimum response, 6 items of 8
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Cooperation_Mean = if_else(
      Cooperation_n_answered >= 6,
      rowMeans(
        across(all_of(cooperation_scale_items)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```

### Cronbach's alpha

```{r}
cooperation_alpha <- psych::alpha(
  df %>%
    select(all_of(cooperation_scale_items))
)

cooperation_alpha
```

```{r}
cooperation_alpha$total$raw_alpha
```

```{r}
cooperation_alpha$total$std.alpha
```

```{r}
cooperation_alpha$item.stats
```

```{r}
cooperation_alpha$alpha.drop
```

### differences by manipulation

```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(motivation) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Cooperation_Mean)),
    mean = mean(Cooperation_Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Cooperation_Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(Cooperation_Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(Cooperation_Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
cooperation_model <- lm(
  Cooperation_Mean ~ motivation,
  data = df
)

anova(cooperation_model)
```

## Remove

### rm()

```{r}
rm(alpha_machiavellianism, alpha_narcissism, alpha_psychopathy, machiavellianism_items, narcissism_items, psychopathy_items)

rm(cooperation_model, cooperation_alpha, competition_items)
rm(cooperation_items, cooperation_scale_items)

rm(nfc_alpha, nfc_items)
```
